statusDefinitions.verified: Direct live DOM/computed-style or published-bundle evidence exists and an automated gate enforces the claim.
statusDefinitions.partial: Some structure or states are source-backed, but known behavior or visual states remain incomplete.
statusDefinitions.unverified: No durable source extraction and automated gate yet.
statusDefinitions.not-applicable: The state does not exist for this surface.

interactionProtocol.scope: Versioned intent identity, strict domain/action registration, target/payload routing, pending and terminal states, multi-control ownership, cancellation and keyed supersession with AbortSignal, optimistic rollback, post-unlock success commit, pessimistic Chat delivery, plain-object adapter results, adapter-only sensitive fields, explicit reference adapter ownership, fail-closed adapter absence, RAH capability gating, backend/network-free reference entries, legacy-event compatibility and shared resizer/disclosure/segmented-control/listbox-select behavior across all nine desktop route families.
knownGaps: mobile.html remains an early standalone component surface rather than a protocol-complete application route

The RAH bridge is verified with an injected FakeRahClient but the current rah_os API has no general execute/message/task-mutation surface; authorization, canonical projections and real transport remain integration work

shell.scope: 64px desktop rail, 62px shared header baseline, rail groups and footer placement only
